title: Carry the Midnight look into email, event pages and the Space page as a real dark surface
detail: Piece 3 of the Mega Theme plan. lib/theme/surface-vars.ts names the per-theme ThemeSurface (ground, text ramp, solid button, accent family, semantic notes) and the scoped --color-* override it paints; lib/theme/surface.ts resolves a Space's surface (pageSurface follows the saved Mega Theme, else the synced website theme; emailSurface follows the theme without the sync switch). MIDNIGHT_SURFACE is the first entry. Email seeds spaceEmailColors from the surface in literal hex (brand accents shade lighter for links and deeper for the soft fill on a dark ground); the Space page layouts and the hosting Space's event page wear it through AccentScope. Themes with no surface keep the app grounds. The anonymous public event page reads the host Space ground through the anon public client only (lib/events/public-surface.ts). Not built: the website-less Space landing.
